$comment: Due-date badge for TargetResolutionDate (Master RAID Log) and DueDate (Action and Decision Tracker). Closed/Completed: grey with a tick. Open and past due: red, warning icon, 'overdue'. Open and due within 7 days: amber, clock, 'due soon'. Otherwise plain. Reads [$Status], so every view that shows the date must include Status (tools/validate_dashboard.py checks this). Empty dates show nothing.

style.border: =if([$Status] == 'Closed' || [$Status] == 'Completed', 'none', if(Number(@currentField) < Number(@now), '1px solid #b91c1c', if(Number(@currentField) <= Number(@now) + 604800000, '1px solid #b45309', 'none')))

children.txtContent: =toLocaleDateString(@currentField) + if([$Status] == 'Closed' || [$Status] == 'Completed', '', if(Number(@currentField) < Number(@now), ' · overdue', if(Number(@currentField) <= Number(@now) + 604800000, ' · due soon', '')))
